records.organization: Xiamen Shuguang Rescue Team · 厦门市曙光救援队
records.services: Flood evacuation, boat rescue, drainage and drone reconnaissance / 水域转移、排涝、无人机侦察
records.coverage: Based in Xiamen; a reported deployment reached Hengzhou, Guangxi in July 2026 under coordinated approvals. This demonstrates cross-province deployment, not guaranteed nationwide availability. A Fujian government report also documents its March–April 2025 earthquake response in Mandalay, Myanmar.

description.en: Based in Xiamen; a reported deployment reached Hengzhou, Guangxi in July 2026 under coordinated approvals. This demonstrates cross-province deployment, not guaranteed nationwide availability. A Fujian government report also documents its March–April 2025 earthquake response in Mandalay, Myanmar.
description.zh: 所在地为厦门；2026年7月报道记载，该队经协调审批赴广西横州救援，证明可跨省出勤，但不代表全国随时可调度。福建省政府报道另记载其2025年3至4月赴缅甸曼德勒参与震后救援。
description.es: Con sede en Xiamen; un despliegue documentado llegó a Hengzhou, Guangxi, en julio de 2026 con las aprobaciones coordinadas. Esto demuestra capacidad de despliegue entre provincias, no disponibilidad garantizada en todo el país. Un informe del gobierno de Fujian también documenta su respuesta al terremoto de marzo–abril de 2025 en Mandalay, Myanmar.
description.fr: Basée à Xiamen ; un déploiement documenté a atteint Hengzhou, au Guangxi, en juillet 2026 après autorisations coordonnées. Cela atteste un déploiement interprovincial, sans garantir une disponibilité nationale. Un rapport du gouvernement du Fujian documente aussi son intervention sismique de mars–avril 2025 à Mandalay, au Myanmar.
description.it: Con sede a Xiamen; un intervento documentato ha raggiunto Hengzhou, nel Guangxi, nel luglio 2026 previa approvazione coordinata.
